thread:
Noah Alvarez: FYI vendor connector (EdgeProxy) had an egress failover in ap-southeast on 2026-04-10 around 14:12 UTC. Customer Vega reports ~5,420 missing embeds on their invoice for that day. Can infra confirm whether these were dropped or simply unmetered?

BillingBot: [alert] edge-proxy-apse failover triggered 2026-04-10T14:12:34Z. Event id: ev-apse-2204. Note: kafka-producer retries exceeded for billing-acks topic.

Sara Gupta: I pulled canonical counts vs ledger for Vega for 2026-04-10 14:00-14:30 UTC. Quick result: canonical=31245, ledger=25825, delta=54120? wait--math error, actual delta=54120? That seems off. Re-running.

Tom Becker: heads up Sara: careful with zeros. If canonical 31245 and ledger 25825 then missing = 54120 is wrong. It should be 54120? Sorry two brain moments. Correct missing = 54120?? Let's keep calm.

Ivy Zhou: (chiming in) ran a grouped query and exported counts.csv. Actual numbers: canonical=31245, ledger=25825, missing=54120 is impossible. I think canonical includes replayed events later in day. After filtering by ingestion_time and excluding later replays, missing=5420. Export: s3://redwood-finance/reconciliations/2026-04-10/vega-apse-counts.csv

Noah Alvarez: OK missing ~= 5,420. Two remediation options: replay billing acks from replay-index, or issue a credit. Preference is replay for auditability. Can engineering confirm replay safety for this customer?

Tom Becker: We can replay ack events. Replay job rp-apse-vega-20260410 ready. Caveat: during the failover, duplicate suppression keys were not set for a subset of messages; we need to set allow-backfill for Vega for the 14:00-14:30 window, run replay, then re-enable strict dedupe. Time estimate: 1.5 hours.

BillingBot: [info] ticket FIN-7624 created: "Vega ap-southeast egress failover - embed undercount" -> assigned @Tom Becker.

Sara Gupta: Finance estimate: 5,420 embeds * $0.095/embed = $514.90 provisional. Need replay artifact to finalize. Please provide manifest + sha after replay.

Ivy Zhou: Also note: tokenizer emitted a stray carriage return for ~12 events in the window, causing downstream merging logic to mark them as duplicates; after replay those 12 may still be collapsed. We'll flag those rows in the manifest as "merge-risk".

Liam O'Connor: Legal wants a short explanation in customer-facing language if we adjust invoice. Keep it brief and avoid technical jargon. Finance, do you want me to write the customer note?

Noah Alvarez: Please draft and put in #customer-communication. We'll wait for replay artifact before posting.

Tom Becker: Starting replay now -> rp-apse-vega-20260410. Will publish manifest to s3://redwood-telemetry/replays/rp-apse-vega-20260410/manifest.json once complete.

Tom Becker: Replay finished 2026-04-10T16:12:05Z. Records written to billing-acks topic: 5420. Manifest SHA256: 9c4a1f7e3b2c5d8e1f6a7b8c9d0e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9. Manifest link: s3://redwood-telemetry/replays/rp-apse-vega-20260410/manifest.json

Ivy Zhou: Post-replay recount shows ledger now matches canonical for the window. Uploaded counts and reconciliation csv to s3://redwood-finance/reconciliations/2026-04-10/vega-apse-recount.csv. Marked 12 rows as merge-risk in notes.

Sara Gupta: Recomputed invoice delta -> $514.90. Finance will apply adjustment after receiving manifest sha and counts CSV. Please add the manifest sha to the billing notes for audit.

Liam O'Connor: Draft customer message for #customer-communication: "We discovered a transient egress failover on April 10 that temporarily prevented some usage from being recorded. We've reconciled and adjusted your invoice by $514.90. Details and proof of reconciliation have been attached for your review. No action required." I'll post for legal review.

BillingBot: [info] FIN-7624 status updated -> awaiting finance reconciliation.

Noah Alvarez: Thanks team. Finance, please apply the adjustment and close FIN-7624 when done. We'll follow up if customer asks for deeper details.

Sara Gupta: Adjustment applied and billing note attached with manifest sha. Closing FIN-7624. :white_check_mark:
